note: The context for the M1 XSD sequence-order pair. Both files in that pair are
the SAME model, so one cases file serves both: the positive control must
evaluate it cleanly, and the negative golden must never get that far because
Xerces rejects it on leg 1 (see the comment at the top of either .dmn).
Supplying a context at all is what makes the positive control a real green:
with no context KIE reports the decision SKIPPED, and etc/kie-dmn-check
counts a SKIPPED decision as a failure -- so a contextless 'pass' here would
be indistinguishable from a harness that did nothing.
